quotes.en: And say: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

quotes.ar: إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَاهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
quotes.en: We have sent it down as an Arabic Qurʾān, so that you may understand.

quotes.ar: قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِي الَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَالَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
quotes.en: Say: are those who know equal to those who do not know?

quotes.ar: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
quotes.en: Whoever treads a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to Paradise.
The best of you are those who learn the Qurʾān and teach it.

quotes.ar: مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ
quotes.en: Whoever Allah intends good for, He gives him understanding of the religion.

quotes.ar: أَحَبُّ الْأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
quotes.en: The deeds most beloved to Allah are the most consistent, even if small.
Learn Arabic, for it is part of your religion.
quotes.source: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb — cited in Iqtiḍāʾ aṣ-Ṣirāṭ al-Mustaqīm

quotes.ar: احْرِصُوا عَلَى تَعَلُّمِ اللُّغَةِ الْعَرَبِيَّةِ فَإِنَّهَا تُثَبِّتُ الْعَقْلَ وَتَزِيدُ فِي الْمُرُوءَةِ
quotes.en: Be keen to learn Arabic, for it steadies the mind and increases nobility of character.
quotes.source: ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb — reported by al-Bayhaqī in Shuʿab al-Īmān

quotes.en: The Arabic tongue is the emblem of Islam and its people.

quotes.ar: مَنْ تَبَحَّرَ فِي النَّحْوِ اهْتَدَى إِلَى كُلِّ الْعُلُومِ
quotes.en: Whoever goes deep into grammar finds his way to every other science.

quotes.ar: أَخِي لَنْ تَنَالَ الْعِلْمَ إِلَّا بِسِتَّةٍ · سَأُنْبِيكَ عَنْ تَفْصِيلِهَا بِبَيَانِ · ذَكَاءٍ وَحِرْصٍ وَاجْتِهَادٍ وَبُلْغَةٍ · وَصُحْبَةِ أُسْتَاذٍ وَطُولِ زَمَانِ
quotes.en: Brother, you will not attain knowledge but by six: intelligence, eagerness, striving, sufficiency, the company of a teacher, and a long stretch of time.
Ṣarf is the mother of the sciences, and naḥw their father.
